howItWorks.title: Our Implementation Process
howItWorks.subtitle: A proven methodology that transforms your business with custom AI Automations and Agents

discovery.title: Discovery and Planning
discovery.description: Our priority is to understand your business, systems, processes, and possibilities. Thanks to an initial consultation, we agree on your requirements and design a personalized technical implementation strategy.

development.title: Custom Development
development.description: The team gets to work, and the technical development process begins. You will have (on average) the prototype of your automation/AI agent in the first week and the final version by the end of the second week.

deployment.title: Seamless Implementation
deployment.description: During the second week, we will integrate the AI Automations/Agents into your business, processes, and systems. Likewise, we will deliver the documentation, conduct the handover session, and close out the implementation.

optimization.title: Continuous Support
optimization.description: We will continue monitoring the implementation's performance and make adjustments for one or two more weeks, optimizing, refining or expanding (if required) to ensure the promised result is achieved.
